verdict.rationale: Databricks documents SQL Alerts that let users define condition rules on query results and automatically deliver notifications (databricks-docs-26), plus Auto Loader/Structured Streaming that automatically trigger processing as new data events arrive (databricks-docs-13, databricks-docs-51). This covers event-triggered automation for a subset of scenarios (query monitoring, data arrival) but there's no evidence of a general-purpose, user-defined event-rule engine spanning arbitrary platform events and actions (e.g., custom event bus, webhook-style triggers) beyond these specific mechanisms. Missing for 10: a broader, AI-native rules/automation framework covering diverse event types and actions, and independent/hands-on corroboration of these alert/trigger features actually working reliably.
